## About
Ken Kallmeyer started Ken's Crescent Springs Service, and it has served the Kenton County communities for towing and auto repair ever since. After Ken passed away, his sons Kevin and Kenny took over to keep his dream alive and continue on the company.
Our crew handles vehicles from the size of go carts to the largest of trucks. Ken's has even been photographed at Cincinnati Northern Kentucky airport recovering airplanes.
In the shop, ASE Master Automobile Technician Kevin works alongside service technicians Mickey, Steven and Matthew on autos, light trucks and heavy trucks. We have the technology and training to repair the newest of automobiles, including updating the computer programming on your car.

## Services
- Towing and recovery: Towing and recovery from light to heavy, including accident recoveries.
- Automobile and light truck repair: Complete service on your automobile or light truck, including internal engine repair and electrical repairs when cost effective.
- Diagnostic: We track down complex problems and simple issues alike with state of the art diagnostic equipment, including a thermal imaging camera.
- Vehicle keys: We have a licensed and certified automobile locksmith on staff who can cut a new key for your vehicle from the vin code.
- Alignment services: Alignment work, offered here since 2018.
- Light to heavy hauling: From light to heavy, we can haul your vehicle damage free.

## FAQ
Q: Is the repair shop open on weekends?
A: No. The repair shop keeps weekday hours and is closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can I get a tow at night?
A: Yes. Towing runs 24 hours, so call dispatch any time.

Q: What if I need service soon?
A: For service sooner than 3 days, please call the office instead of requesting an appointment online.

Q: Can I email you on the weekend?
A: You can, but email is not checked on the weekends or after hours. For towing, call dispatch.
